source_title: Princess Cruises Sets the Stage for Extraordinary Discovery Down Under in 2028-29 - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Season Features Three Ships in Australia & New Zealand with the Longest Ever Roundtrip World Cruise From Australia Visiting 61 Destinations Across 31 Countries
FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla. , Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Princess Cruises unveils its 2028â29 Australia and New Zealand season alongside the 2029 Grand World Odyssey . Together, this collection offers four experiences in one extraordinary season spanning the spectacular landscapes of Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific, as well as some of the world's most celebrated cities and remote destinations. All voyages go on sale November 10, 2026.
"Princess Cruises has a long and proud history of inspiring guests to explore the world, and our 2028â29 season takes that spirit of discovery to extraordinary new heights," said Jim Berra, Princess Cruises Chief Commercial Officer. "From the longest World Cruise ever to sail roundtrip out of Australia to an unmatched variety of voyages showcasing the beauty of Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific, we're giving guests more ways to discover remarkable destinations, immerse themselves in different cultures and see the world in new ways."
2029 Grand World Odyssey: 129 Nights of Extraordinary Discovery The longest World Cruise ever offered roundtrip from Australia, the 2029 Grand World Odyssey promises an adventure of a lifetime, connecting five continents and some of the planet's most fascinating destinations.
Sailing aboard Grand Princess , the 129-night Grand World Odyssey spans approximately 37,300 nautical miles and visits 61 destinations across 31 countries. Along the way, guests will experience the cultural treasures of Europe and the Mediterranean, the natural wonders of the South Pacific, the vibrant cities of the Americas, and some of the world's most remote islands all in one unforgettable global adventure.
Highlights of the 2029 Grand World Odyssey include:
129 Nights, Five Continents: An extraordinary journey spanning approximately 37,300 nautical miles, visiting 61 destinations in 31 countries.
51 UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Opportunities to discover some of the world's most treasured cultural, historical and natural landmarks.
More Time Ashore: Nine More Ashore experiences throughout Europe, South America and the South Pacific, including eight late-night stays and one overnight call, allowing guests to experience destinations beyond traditional daytime visits.
Iconic Cities & Destinations Around the World: Visits to New York City, Miami, Reykjavik, Lisbon, Barcelona, Copenhagen, Tahiti and Auckland, among other celebrated destinations.
Panama Canal Adventure: Two full transits through the Panama Canal's new locks, one of the world's most impressive engineering achievements.
Remote Island Discovery: Scenic cruising near Easter Island, famous for its mysterious moai statues, and Pitcairn Island, one of the world's most isolated inhabited islands and home to descendants of the HMS Bounty mutineers.
A Truly Global Journey: Crossing the Equator twice and the International Date Line twice, connecting extraordinary destinations across multiple oceans and hemispheres.
Guests can begin their World Cruise adventure from Sydney, Brisbane or Melbourne, with an additional departure opportunity from Dover, the gateway to London.
2028â29 Australia & New Zealand: More Ways to Explore Down Under Princess' 2028â29 Australia and New Zealand program delivers exceptional itinerary variety with over 90 departures across over 70 unique itineraries aboard three ships. Voyages range from two to 46 nights, offering guests everything from short escapes to extended adventures exploring the region's spectacular coastlines, vibrant cities, extraordinary wildlife and rich cultural heritage.
Three Princess Ships: Grand Princess , Emerald Princess and Royal Princess sailing throughout the region.
42 Destinations Across Six Countries: Exploring the diverse landscapes, cultures and natural wonders of Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific.
10 UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Opportunities to discover some of the region's most significant natural and cultural treasures.
11 More Ashore Experiences: Late-night and overnight port calls providing additional time to explore.
Six Departure Ports: Convenient sailings from Adelaide, Auckland, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth (Fremantle) and Sydney.
17 Round Australia Voyages: Extended journeys showcasing Australia's remarkable coastline and diverse destinations.
The season also marks the welcome return of Emerald Princess to Australia for the first time since the 2016-17 season, along with renewed homeporting opportunities in Melbourne and an expanded selection of New Zealand cruising.
Extraordinary Wildlife, Natural Wonders and Cultural Discoveries From encounters with Australia's iconic wildlife to breathtaking scenic cruising, the 2028â29 season offers memorable experiences both on land and at sea.
Among the standout destinations and experiences:
Phillip Island, Australia â The Little Penguin Parade: Witness one of Australia's most beloved wildlife spectacles as hundreds of Little Penguins, the world's smallest penguin species, emerge from the ocean at sunset and make their way across the beach to their burrows.
Kangaroo Island, Australia â Wildlife in Its Natural Habitat: Discover one of Australia's premier wildlife destinations, where kangaroos roam freely, koalas rest in eucalyptus trees, Australian sea lions gather along pristine beaches and rare birdlife thrives.
Kimberley Coast, Australia â Ancient Landscapes and Dramatic Scenery: Experience the remote beauty of Australia's northwest coast, where towering red cliffs, dramatic gorges, cascading waterfalls and untouched islands reveal landscapes shaped over billions of years.
New Zealand â Spectacular Scenery and Coastal Discovery: Explore Fiordland National Park and the country's breathtaking landscapes, charming coastal communities and remarkable natural beauty through an expanded selection of itineraries across both the North and South Islands.
South Pacific â Tropical Island Escapes: Discover island destinations known for turquoise waters, welcoming cultures, lush landscapes and laid-back tropical charm.
More Time to Experience Every Destination Combined with Princess' signature onboard hospitality, exceptional dining , entertainment and relaxing accommodations , the 2028â29 season offers an exceptional way to explore Australia, New Zealand and beyond with Princess shore excursions .
Booking Information Princess is offering an Early Booking Bonus on 2028-29 Australia and New Zealand voyages with up to $500 instant savings, up to $500 onboard credit, reduced $100 deposits, early access to dining reservations and arrival groups, a free location upgrade and up to $300 in savings for Captain's Circle members. The Early Booking Bonus for the 2029 Grand World Odyssey cruise includes up to $3,000 in onboard credit plus up to $2,000 in Captain's Circle savings. Both offers are available from November 10, 2026, through February 16, 2027.
Additional information about Princess Cruises is available through a professional travel advisor, by calling 1-800-PRINCESS (1-800-774-6237) or visiting www.princess.com .
About Princess Cruises: Princess Cruises, the original Love Boat, has been creating enriching vacations shaped by discovery, human connection, and personalized service for more than 60 years. Sailing to more than 345 destinations in over 90 countries across all seven continents, Princess invites millions of guests to experience new places, people, and cultures in meaningful ways. Recognized as the world's most iconic cruise brand, Princess is known for thoughtfully curated global itineraries, well-appointed staterooms, exceptional dining and entertainment, and immersive experiences onboard and ashore. By bringing together thoughtful service, elevated experiences, and extraordinary destinations, Princess creates meaningful moments, lasting connections and stories worth sharing long after the journey ends. Princess Cruises is part of Carnival Corporation, the world's largest cruise company, with a portfolio of cruise lines operating in more than 800 ports and destinations worldwide (NYSE: CCL ).
